name: Defense Secretary Pete
description: Follow Defense Secretary Pete, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Watch Live: Hegseth and Caine testify before Senate panel amid escalating Iran war
changes.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said the administration estimates that the Iran war has cost $37.5 billion since it began in late February.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Defense secretary Pete Hegseth will appear on the Hill on Tuesday. He's looking for a nearly $90 billion funding boost, as the Iran war once again flares.

changes.title: Sen. Chris Murphy on the Iran war and Pete Hegseth's upcoming Senate testimony
changes.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., about the escalating war in the Middle East and the testimony of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in front of a Senate panel on Tuesday.

changes.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has spoken about a range of issues in recent days — from testosterone to leak investigations — but he has said little about the war.
